noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 5 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.740 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.701

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 13.31 vs bruit blanc 0.09
     - Hurst max: 1.108, Pente FFT: -1.777
  2. energy (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 10.96 vs bruit blanc 0.09
     - Hurst max: 0.932, Pente FFT: -0.829
  3. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 17.31 vs bruit blanc 0.09
     - Hurst max: 0.881, Pente FFT: -0.537

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.720
  2. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.814
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.701)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.896
